generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders are not accepted
The employer reserves the right to reject one and all tenders without assigning any reason there of.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
Original documents/ Certificates enclosed must be produced in the office of Executive Engineer at the time of opening of technical bid.
All the items in the tender are inclusive of cost and conveyance of all materials, all lead ,lift, loading, unloading, transportation, labour, hire chares of machinery , curing for concrete works
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act

In case of the death of a contractor, after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, is an eligible registered contractor and is willing, can execute and complete the work, at the accepted tender rates, irrespective of the cost of the work
Department will not supply any materials
The contractor should maintain the work during the defective liability period, i.e. for 2 years at his own cost
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Bid document KW- IV.

The tenderer should bear all cost associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be resposble and liable for those cost.The cost of the tender form shall not be refundable
Materials like Bitumen, steel,cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority before used on the work.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class III & above Registration and the tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

Any tender aggrieved by an order passed by the tender accepting authority other than the government under section 13 may appeal through Karnataka Public Procurement Portal only. written appeals will not be accepted.
As per G.O.letter No:AD 417 expenditure 12/ 2024 Dated 9.8.2024,The Govt and contractor are bound to pay/refund accordingly if the GST rates are revised during the contract period

The Successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding royalty Charges. The contractor has to submit Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) for all naturally available Resources/ Materials along with the running contract bills, otherwise necessary action will be taken as per GO/Circulars
Contractor shall bare the expenditure/charges towards design mix paid to quality control sub division

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 (As per the circular from Govt. of Karnataka No:12/2024 Bangalore Dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit Declaration Certificate which is duly signed by the bidder along with their proposal.

The contractor has to quote the same rate to the same repeated items of work with same rate (same item code and rate) that has to be executed at different chainages If in case, the contractor quotes different rates for the same repeated items with the same rate appearing in BOQ then, the lowest quoted rate for the same repeated items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.
